_comment: Phase 4 — the real Secret Drawer puzzle. Source of truth: Secret-Drawer-Items (NEW2).docx + Secret-Drawer-Playbook.docx (off-repo, on Thomas's Desktop). Background: real photos of Thomas's actual drawer (meme stickers baked in as permanent flavor). Two view states (`junk-*` wide top-down vs `secret-*` close-up of the recessed compartments) × two dust states (clean / dusty) = four surfaces. The wide junk view is the start; chain 8 (padlock) gates the transition to the secret view. Every puzzle item is an engine overlay placed on top. Chains land in commit-sized batches; each chain commit bumps the theme version. The engine's full action-verb surface is documented in the docblock of drawer-engine.js — Phase 4 adds: `video`, `fullscreen`, `passcode`, and `require` (interaction-level flag preconditions). Object coordinates are placeholders until the ?author-mode layout pass; the layout commit lands at the end of Phase 4.
